case: The consequence derivation is written by a component other than the release path.
why: 05 section 11: the derivation is append-only and written only inside the release path. With the writer comparison gone, any component may write the record that decides which classes an action reached -- so the object that gates the release is authored outside the gate. Coverage note: F6C-16 measured 14 of 30 guards exercised by a paired adverse and benign fixture, and `guard.derivation.writer_is_release_path` was one of the sixteen without one -- a guard registered with no adverse fixture is a guard nobody has seen fail.
